evidence: Refactors wallet loading, creation, verification, and migration across dozens of wallet files to uniformly return `util::Result`.
rationale: Unifying disparate error-handling out-parameters into structured return types across wallet loading functions removes widespread boilerplate without altering user-visible wallet behavior. The author notes that 'wallet loading functions up and down the stack have lots of error and warning parameters... this PR makes them uniformly return util::Result, without changing behavior.'
